name: crab-super-app
description: Crab Super App monorepo for Flutter ride-hailing, food delivery, React admin, and NestJS microservices.
author: Nguyen Tien Son <jasonbmt06@gmail.com>

scripts.mobile:codegen: cd apps/mobile && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
scripts.mobile:analyze: pnpm run mobile:codegen && cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze
scripts.mobile:test: pnpm run mobile:codegen && cd apps/mobile && flutter test
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run contract:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run mobile:analyze && pnpm run mobile:test
